d: Takshashila naresh ambhikumar apni vishal sena lekar alakshendr se milne pahunchta hai, aur use apne pradesh lekar aa jata hai. vahan mahal men rajkumari alka nagar chhor kar jana chahti hai, alakshendr ke aagman se chandragupt bahut asantusht hai aur vah use marne jana chahta hai, magar uska sathi use nahin jane deta..... aage kya hota hai dekhie is bhag men.
